entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What is this place?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Who're they?

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: My name is Igor.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: I am the master of the Velvet Room.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: I am Lavenza, a resident of this place as[n]well. We have been waiting for all of you.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Velvet Room?

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: My master has just been released from[n]a long period of imprisonment. His[n]powers have not fully returned.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Though it may be presumptuous of me,[n]I will speak on his—

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey, where's Morgana?

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Would you like to see him?
Of course we would.
You know him?

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: ...He's right over there.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That's where you were hidin'!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I... was born here.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It was to dispel an evil being from man's[n]spiritual world...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Mona?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: My role was to find the Trickster and[n]help him defeat it.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's why I was created here by my[n]master.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Indeed.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I really remember everything.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: When this place was about to be taken[n]over, my master gathered the last traces[n]of mankind's hope.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...He mustered up his remaining strength[n]to make me.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: The entity that calls itself a god is a[n]malevolent will that forces man into[n]everlasting servitude.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: It hopes to attain eternal peace by filling[n]reality with those who have stopped[n]thinking for themselves.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: ...That is the ruin of man that this evil god[n]envisions.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I... um... don't get what you're sayin' at all—

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Be quiet and listen! We don't have much[n]time left!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Wait a moment. The Holy Grail is...[n]a "god"?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I was wondering why it had a will of its[n]own, but are you implying that it isn't[n]a Treasure?

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: No. As the distorted desires of the masses,[n]it is most certainly the core of Mementos[n]itself.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Then... did the Treasure become a god[n]because people wished to be ruled over?

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: That is correct.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: To decide the fate of the world, it chose[n]two people with potential and pitted[n]them against each other.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: One—Goro Akechi—incited the masses'[n]distortion. Had he won, the world[n]would've been destroyed and remade.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: The other was a Trickster who would[n]stand up against this... That was[n][f 4 3].

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If [fName] won, the human world[n]would be left as is...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Those were the conditions of the game—[n]at least, that's what should've happened.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: That malevolent being knew that a[n]revolution would not occur within[n]indolent humans.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: After all, it is the masses' distorted desires[n]incarnate.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: However, my true master believed in[n]humanity.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: He believed that a Trickster would rise[n]among the people and accomplish this[n]change.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: But that evil entity laughed at the[n]prospect, and sought to prove the[n]powerlessness of man with the game.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: And [f 4 3] had great[n]potential... which is why it approached[n]him.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: It helped train the Trickster, only to cast[n]him into despair, using the masses who[n]rejected their savior.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: This was likely its means to nip in the bud[n]anything that would pose a threat.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Now that I think back to when I was[n]separated, I felt a disagreement to[n]the word "rehabilitation."

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Of course I did... It was just a means for[n]the fake to keep you under surveillance.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Basically, this guy was dragged into[n]a game where the evil god rigged[n]the outcome.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dammit, what the hell!?

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Your real world has already been fused[n]with Mementos.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: You do not exist because reality is replete[n]with the cognition of those who deny the[n]Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: It can be said that the world is one step[n]away from the evil god's machinations.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: However, there is still hope,[n][f 4 3]...

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Now that the evil god's identity has been[n]exposed, you can see your rehabilitation[n]to its completion.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Only you can leave this prison and[n]save this distorted world and its captive[n]people...

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Young man, guided by Morgana and[n]worthy of the Trickster name...

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: You must challenge the evil god and[n]reclaim your existence in reality.[n]Are you up to the task?
Of course.
I'm not confident.
Reclaim my existence?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let's destroy that annoying, shiny[n]Treasure jerk for sure this time!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You'll be fine. You're not doing this alone.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You've got us, you know?

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: *chuckle* Excellent...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: There is nothing to fear. You already[n]possess the strength to oppose this[n]evil god.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: *chuckle* I am truly looking forward to[n]this!

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Our mutual friend knows where the exit is.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: Morgana, please guide them.

entries.speaker: Lavenza
entries.en: And thank you for all that you've done.[n]It's a cruel responsibility that's been cast[n]upon you...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I will accept your words of appreciation[n]fully when everything is over.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Now follow me!
